title: Rest-Day Compliance After Long Run
dataSources: Strava API activities (`strava:activity`), Garmin Connect (`garmin:activity`), Fitbit Web API (`fitbit:activity`), Peloton workout history (`peloton:workout`), Zwift ride exports (`zwift:activity`).
app: Strava / Garmin Connect / Fitbit / Peloton / Zwift APIs and webhooks via Splunk HEC scripted inputs; GPX/FIT/CSV activity exports ingested as file inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=strava:activity sport=Run
| sort 0 athlete _time
| streamstats current=f last(eval(if(distance_km>=18,_time,null()))) as prev_long_run_time by athlete
| eval hours_since_long_run=round((_time-prev_long_run_time)/3600,1)
| where prev_long_run_time>0 AND hours_since_long_run<24
| sort - _time
description: Checks whether you sneak in another run too soon after a long run, catching the classic habit of skipping the recovery day you promised yourself.
value: Many hobby injuries come from ignoring easy recovery rules, not from a single dramatic workout; this query spots the recovery shortcut immediately.
implementation: Tag long runs with distance and load them into Splunk; alert whenever another run lands within 24 hours of a long effort.
visualization: Table of follow-on runs started less than 24 hours after a long run.
grandmaExplanation: It maps when you go back out running too soon after a big effort instead of taking the recovery day your legs need.
